purpose: Propagate request cancellation through clipboard payload preparation and prevent departed callers from publishing prepared copies.

baseline.reproduction: FAIL on the unchanged implementation: a cancelled media waiter remained blocked for the full 1-second observation (test completed at 1.18s), subsequently reached payload cloning/validation and published. Cancellation during text or file preparation also allowed publication.

change.context: Resident-agent Clipboard passes its request context into SyncClipboardLocalChange. Expired calls return before reserving or clearing a local copy.
change.serialization: Reuse syncgate.Mutex.LockContext for the one-media-preparation gate. No polling or detached lock-waiting goroutine is added.
change.publication: Check cancellation before preparation and again under clipboard.mu before publishing. Keep peer, local epoch and payload permission checks.
change.interfaces: Internal Go method signature changes only. No HTTP/JSON API, peer protocol, DB, installer, repository hygiene or runner changes. Existing SyncClipboardPayload convenience callers retain their background-context behavior.

validation.focused: PASS: cancelled media waiter 0.05s; cancellation during text/file preparation 0.08s total; expired request preserving an existing copy 0.03s. Durations include fixtures, not production latency measurements or guarantees.
validation.packages: PASS: go test -timeout 3m ./internal/peerupdate ./internal/residentagent ./internal/localapi ./internal/syncgate (12.943s, 8.134s, 7.332s, 0.169s), using the runtime STW overlay and local toolchain.
validation.operationPath: PASS: TestClipboardOperationPreservesCancellationAfterAuthorization (0.09s), added after package validation to verify that the actual resident-agent call preserves cancellation even after its first authorization check.
validation.vet: PASS: go vet for the same four packages; residentagent vet repeated after adding its operation-path regression.
validation.hygiene: PASS: changed Go files formatted with gofmt; git diff --check.
validation.skipped: Frontend, full repository, installer/release packaging and physical two-PC acceptance: no UI, wire, installer or input-worker changes. Existing unchanged package checks were reused.

remainingRisk: Preparation already running is bounded by existing size/validation limits and is not preempted internally. Cancellation is observed before publication, not atomically synchronized with a later context cancellation. This does not fix or verify intermittent input recovery or handoff latency.
